neighbours.label: the word completing an action that is avoided or prevented ('managed not to drop', 'instead of being shut down'), as against the same action when it actually happens
fire: Somehow the goalkeeper managed not to drop the ball in the rain.
The factory was sold to a rival instead of being shut down.
Luckily I managed not to spill the coffee on my laptop.
The old cinema was restored instead of being torn down.
The pilot managed not to crash the plane in the storm.
The team avoided getting shut out with a late goal.
The museum was renovated rather than closed down.
She somehow managed not to lose her keys this time.
quiet: In the rain, the goalkeeper dropped the ball twice.
The factory was sold to a rival company last spring.
Sadly I spilled the coffee all over my laptop.
The old cinema was painted blue by the new owners.
The pilot landed the plane safely during the storm.
The team scored a late goal in the second half.
The museum was renovated over three long years.
She lost her keys again on the way to work.
